approval_source: explicit user chat: ## B 场次列表＋双区工作台
approval_scope: Studio composition only; not implementation or test acceptance; Orders C unchanged
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot, landscape about 1586x992, front-on flat screen, not a poster, not a photo of a monitor. This is a Chinese merchant live-commerce SaaS Studio planning and local MOCK rehearsal page. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: inherit its navy #193c61 sidebar, cool white/light-gray workspace, teal #247965 main actions, system Arial/PingFang typography, thin #dde5ee borders, subtle 5px controls and 7px surfaces, flat no shadows. DO NOT copy order/payment/customer content or order layout. Fixed outer shell: 214px dark sidebar with brand 直播商家工作台, nav 商品, 库存, 订单, 直播工作区 (selected), 网站客服, Meta消息, 平台支持, 设置; 66px topbar store 演示店铺 on left, 简体中文 and 商家账号 on right. Core page title 直播工作室, visible small note 设计示例 · 仅本地模拟，不会公开直播. Exact useful content: selected synthetic session 秋季好物介绍; other sessions 周末上新 and 新品预告; form fields 场次名称, 计划时间（UTC）, 画幅; values 秋季好物介绍, 2026/09/30 12:00, 9:16; buttons 保存草稿 and 新建场次 each appear once. Clearly separate persisted programme 草稿 / 版本 1 from rehearsal and media observations. Include small text block 已准备模拟授权; destinations Facebook and Instagram each marked 公开状态未验证. Local demo ready state: no attempt yet, display 尚未开始 and button 开始模拟演练 once. Text note 不代表真实平台开播资格. No actual stream/video preview/camera, audience/revenue KPIs, recording, chat panels, product pinning, claims of real platform connection or fictional live success. Avoid a wall of repeated cards. All core Chinese labels legible, generous but purposeful spacing, realistic crisp UI, no browser chrome. Render one complete coherent first viewport. Composition B: after the page heading, a 260px narrow session list on the left inside workspace, three dense rows, selected first lightly blue; 新建场次 above list. The remaining workspace is a split workbench: wide central programme form with single 保存草稿, and one 300px right status rail, joined by one thin vertical rule, not floating mini cards. Status rail headed 模拟演练, with small MOCK label, 已准备模拟授权, Facebook and Instagram destinations with 公开状态未验证, state 尚未开始, and single teal 开始模拟演练. Local-only warning at top. Clear contrast between editable programme and factual status; all task-relevant data visible together without duplicate CTAs or KPI boxes.
usage: composition-only; binding and actual input constraints come from frozen contract, no automatic authorization on save
